files.title: BA LL. B., BBA LL.B., and LL. B.
files.programme: B.A. LL.B., BBA LL.B., and LL.B.

subjects.title: Introduction to Civil and Criminal Manual

units.title: Introduction to Civil Manual
units.topics: Establishment, Lawyers, Lawyer's Fees and Clerks, Preparation and Institution of Suits, Court Fees and Process Fees, Interim relief, Discovery, Inspection, and Interrogatories, Issue of Process, Hearing and Trial of Suits, Judgment, Decree and Execution, Copies and Copying Fees, Appellate Remedies and Procedures.

units.title: Introduction to Criminal Manual
units.topics: Criminal Courts and their Powers, Information to Police, Arrest & Investigation, Framing of Charge, Evidence in Inquiries and Trials, Trials by Courts of Session, General Rules as to Inquiries and Trials, Appeals and Revision Applications, Appeals to High Court, Execution of Sentences and Orders, Juvenile Justice.

units.title: Bombay High Court Appellate Side Rules, 1960
units.topics: Jurisdiction of Single Judges / Benches, Powers of Registrar, Presentation and Filing of Appeals, Appeals under Clause 15 of Letters Patent, Procedure in Case of Default, Preparation of Paper Books and Translations, Certified Copies, Writs under Article 226, Appeals to the Supreme Court.

units.title: Introduction to the Supreme Court Rules, 2013
units.topics: Offices of the Court, Sittings and Vacation, Officers, Advocates, Business in Chambers, Constitution of Division Courts and Powers of Single Judge, Documents, Notices of Motion, Judgments, Decrees and Orders, Petitions, Hearing of Appeals, Appeals on Certificate, Criminal Appeals, SLP.

units.title: Introduction to E-Courts
units.topics: e-Filing Rules of the High Court of Bombay 2022, Digital Justice Framework, Distinction: Physical / Virtual / Hybrid Hearings, Online Registration, Drafting and Filing of Digital Pleadings, PDF Bookmarking & Digital Signatures, e-Seva Kendras, VC Rules 2022, Mock VC Session.
